review.notes: All 6 physical pages' extracted text was block-compared against the OCR markdown after normalization, plus a whole-document numeric multiset check. All five figure captions (Fig. 1-5) are transcribed in the OCR next to their embedded figure images; the decimals flagged by the numeric check live inside the Fig. 3/5 plot images (axis ticks) and inside the Algorithm 1 code listing, both legitimate. The 'arXiv:2512.05964v2' string is the page-1 margin watermark, not body content. Pi-0.6 references are present as math spans. The Algorithm 1 listing (physical p.6) is inside a balanced ```python fence and its 40 lines match the PDF listing line-for-line; physical p.6 was rendered at 130 dpi and visually checked, confirming the printed for-loop body is indented one level deeper than the 'for' statement, which OCR flattened to the same indent, producing invalid Python. That single re-indentation is the only patch. Source-printed quirks kept: none observed.

patches.after:

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.6 (viewed at 130 dpi) shows the Algorithm 1 sample_actions listing with the five loop-body lines indented one level (8 spaces at OCR's 4-space unit) beneath 'for _ in range(num_steps):'; OCR repeated the same 4-space indent for the body, which is syntactically invalid Python. Only whitespace changes; the code text is otherwise identical to the printed listing.
